👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, pichle 20 saalon me Bharat ne woh karke dikhaya hai jo kai developed nations bhi nahi kar paaye hain! Chahe woh Chandrayaan‑3 ki historic landing ho ya Mars Orbiter Mission ka first attempt me hi successful ho jaana. Lekin doston, ek taraf jahan hum space technology me world records tod chuke hain, wahi dusri taraf kuch cases me Indian infrastructure ki haalat itni kharab hai ki humare bridges collapse ho rahe hain. Mumbai jaise sheher me ₹74,000 crore ke budget ke baad bhi achhe raste nahi ban paate, aur kabhi kabhi toh poora ka poora bridge hi gir jaata hai.

Ussi tarah Bharatmala Pariyojana jo originally ₹5 lakh crore me banne wali thi, ab lagbhag ₹10 lakh crore tak pahunch chuki hai. Mumbai–Ahmedabad Bullet Train jo 2022 tak complete hone wali thi, ab 2029 tak push ho chuki hai. Aur Navi Mumbai International Airport — jiska idea 1990s me aaya tha — woh bhi lagbhag 20 saal ke delay ke baad finally ban payi.

Toh sawaal yeh hai ki jab ek taraf Bharat world records tod raha hai, wahi desh apne roads aur bridges ko efficiently fix kyu nahi kar pa raha? South Korea, Japan aur United Kingdom jaise deshon ne is infrastructural problem ko kaise solve kiya? Aur sabse bada sawaal — duniya se India ko kaun se lessons seekhne chahiye taaki hum bhi world-class infrastructure build kar sakein?
